name: Butterfly Stretch
description: Sit with the soles of the feet together and knees open to stretch the inner thighs.

items.content: Sit on the sitting bones, bringing the soles together and letting the knees open comfortably.
Hold the ankles lightly and lift through the chest without arching the lower back.
Keep feet farther from the pelvis if the knees feel strained; support the thighs with cushions if needed.
Breathe and let the hips relax; do not press or bounce the knees downward.

stages.name: Hold
stages.description: Seated upright with soles of feet touching, knees open to the sides and hands lightly holding the ankles. Back long and shoulders relaxed.
